sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A big single-target burn with two invulnerable orb-catching phases and a core-exposure damage phase in between.

sections.heading: Orb phases (66% / 33%)
bullets: Keep Construct goes invulnerable while colored orbs (Xera's Energy) move toward it from the statues.
Match your attunement color to a statue and intercept its orb — letting orbs through stacks a damage buff on the boss, so don't miss yours.

sections.heading: Core phase
bullets: Once Xera's Embrace is stripped, the breakbar opens up — break it to expose the core.
Clear the phantasms guarding the core, then pull the core through the rifts to stack vulnerability before burning it down.

sections.heading: Red circles (Xera's Fury)
bullets: Expanding red circles spawn under each player — spread out so a filled circle only catches you, not the group.
